answers.rationale: The history supports a conditional preference for flexibility when schedules, weather, or hotel details remain uncertain—not a fixed refusal of prepaid terms. The user explicitly said prepaid can be acceptable when savings are real, while prior prepaid recommendations were rejected because savings were small or the itinerary was still changeable. With a finalized conference, named room, breakfast, itemized folio, and materially lower direct-package total, the prepaid package is the calibrated choice.
